# SC-500 Practice Section 2

[![Open in Quiz Player](https://img.shields.io/badge/Open_in-Quiz_Player-blue?style=for-the-badge&logo=data:image/svg+xml;base64,)](https://quizplay.io/quiz.html?source=quizplay-io/quiz-player-quizzes-sc-500-question-set-2)

![Preview](assets/images/preview_sc500.svg)

Second practice question set for the **Implementing End-to-End Security Controls for Cloud and AI Workloads (SC-500)** certification exam — the successor to AZ-500. This set approaches the same four exam domains from angles that complement Set 1: custom Azure roles and entitlement management, Key Vault key rotation and Defender for Key Vault, immutable (WORM) storage, Azure Files identity-based authentication, Always Encrypted and ledger tables, Azure Virtual Network Manager, Private Link services, Virtual WAN secured hubs, Trusted Launch VMs, Azure Machine Configuration, container registry hardening, AI runtime protection (Copilot Studio agents, Entra Agent ID blast radius, Foundry output guardrails, shadow-AI data loss prevention), and Microsoft Sentinel data engineering (custom tables, retention tiers, Windows Event Forwarding).

## Content Overview

- **36 Questions** — 12 case-study linked + 24 standalone; single choice, multiple choice, ordering, and matching
- **Topics**:
  - Manage Identity, Access, and Governance (20–25%)
  - Secure Storage, Databases, and Networking (25–30%)
  - Secure Compute, including Security for AI (20–25%)
  - Manage and Monitor Security Posture (20–25%)

## What This Does Not Cover

This question set focuses on **security configuration and design decisions** for cloud and AI workloads. It does not cover penetration testing techniques, detailed KQL query authoring, or click-by-click portal walkthroughs. It is not a substitute for official Microsoft Learn training paths.

## Disclaimer

> [!IMPORTANT]
> These questions are **AI-generated** for study and practice purposes. They are **not** exam dumps and do not contain actual questions from the Microsoft certification exam. Use them to test your understanding of Azure and Microsoft security concepts, not as a substitute for official study materials.
